about: Goals for scripts/health.py, shown on the Code Health wiki page. A baseline of null is filled from the first release the scorecard measures. Each count's next milestone is half the previous one (baseline/2, /4, ...) until the long-term target; a count that should rise gets +10% steps (coverage: +5 points). A measure marked milestones: false is watched rather than driven: the page only flags it when it drifts past its baseline. Change goals in a reviewed pull request, like the layer rules. See docs/architecture/HEALTH.md.

coverage.about: Scope of the coverage goal: production lines of the files in these layers (scripts/arch_check.py), minus generated files and these paths (a folder ends with a slash; anything else is one exact file).

exclude.why: GPU rendering: needs a graphics device, which unit tests do not have.
GPU rendering: needs a graphics device, which unit tests do not have.
Graphics backend selection: needs a graphics device.

measures.label: Upward dependencies (files)
measures.why: Lower layers that do not reach up can be built, tested and reused without the app.

measures.label: Upward module pairs
measures.why: Each pair is a place where a lower layer depends on a higher one.

measures.label: Modules that use each other
measures.why: Two modules that depend on each other change together and cannot be understood apart.

measures.label: Files over 3,000 lines
measures.why: Large files are hard to review and collect merge conflicts.

measures.label: Functions over 150 lines
measures.why: Long functions are hard to test and to change safely.

measures.label: Top-level Message variants
measures.why: One enum for every event couples all features to the app module.

measures.label: unwrap/expect/panic! in production code
measures.why: A panic closes the app and can lose unsaved work; returning an error lets the user recover.

measures.label: unwrap/expect/panic! in file import and export (src/io)
measures.why: A damaged or unusual drawing, or a failed export, should give an error message, never a crash.

measures.label: unsafe without a SAFETY note
measures.why: A SAFETY note records why the code is sound, so later changes keep it sound.

measures.label: Clippy warnings
measures.why: Clippy's default lints catch common mistakes and unclear code.

measures.label: Compiler warnings
measures.why: With zero warnings, a new one is noticed.

measures.label: Files rustfmt would change
measures.why: One format means diffs show only real changes.

measures.label: Line coverage of the core layers (%)
measures.why: Every line a test runs is a line a change cannot silently break.

measures.label: Test functions (#[test])
measures.why: Tests let contributors change code without fear of breaking it.

measures.label: Crates in the dependency tree
measures.why: Each crate adds build time and supply-chain risk.
